mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rm.role_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != '' AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 0 AND r.status = 0 AND r.deleted = 0
SELECT role_id FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT user_id AS userId, role_id AS roleId FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id IN
#{uid}
SELECT DISTINCT r.role_key FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 0 AND r.deleted = 0
SELECT MIN(r.data_scope) FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 0 AND r.deleted = 0

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.tenant_id, u.dept_id, u.status, u.deleted FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id = #{targetUserId} AND u.id NOT IN (1, 3) AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.status = 0 AND u.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM org_employee e WHERE e.user_id = u.id AND e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.status IN (1, 2) ) LIMIT 1

SELECT ur.user_id FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id WHERE r.role_key = #{roleKey} AND r.status = 0 AND r.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 0 AND u.deleted = 0 ORDER BY u.id ASC LIMIT 1
